text:
mira: Heads-up: scheduling an infra apply for release-2026.02 (prod-eu) at 03:30 UTC. Changes: IAM role for model-worker, provider bump requested by modules to aws 3.7.0. Want to pin to avoid transitive breakage and run a brief canary.

deploybot: preflight: running `terraform plan` on branch release-2026.02...

deploybot: plan summary: +2 resources, ~2 to update, 0 deletes. provider mismatch detected: module/compute uses `hashicorp/aws` 3.6.2, requested 3.7.0.

lee: If 3.7.0 is required for a security fix, we should schedule a dedicated provider bump window. Otherwise, pin to `>=3.6.2, <3.7.0`.

toni: Agreed. Pinning is safer for this release. Also: we need an explicit tfstate backup step and a revert command in the runbook.

mira: I'll push provider pin to `module/compute` and `module/iam` in `infra/lock-provider-3-6-2` and attach the PR. Will add runbook excerpts before we remove the hold.

deploybot: hold placed by @mira at 02:50 UTC. Queue position: 3. Preflight shows provider pin missing. To proceed: remove hold with `/deploybot resume 7481123456`.

vincent: Runbook sketch (put into release notes):
- snapshot tfstate: `aws s3 cp s3://tfstate/releases/release-2026-02.tfstate ./snapshot-7481123456.tfstate`
- disable new role (tag `deployed=false`) if rollback needed
- revert commit `git revert <sha>` and reapply

lee: Canary plan: shift 5% traffic to new role for 20m. Smoke checks: auth handshake, token refresh, sync job cron run. Bail criteria: >=4% error over 5m or any auth failures.

ops-oncall: Change window approved 03:30-04:30 UTC. I'll prepare dashboards and set alert on 4% error sustained. Oncall standby 03:20-04:45 UTC.

mira: PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/978. Tagging @lee to confirm smoke scripts.

lee: smoke scripts in `ops/smoketests/iam_quickcheck.sh`. I'll kick them off post-apply.

deploybot: preflight re-run: provider pins found. Plan unchanged. All preflight checks PASS. Queue position: 1. Ready to execute when hold removed.

mira: Removing hold at 03:25 UTC. Will execute at 03:30 UTC. Final: ops-oncall ok? @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: Dashboards and alerts configured. Added runbook link to incident channel. :white_check_mark:

mira: Triggering apply now `/deploybot apply 7481123456 --auto-approve`.

deploybot: APPLY started. logs: https://deploys.internal/7481123456

deploybot: APPLY completed 1: 2 added, 2 changed, 0 destroyed. Scheduling smoke tests and canary shift.

lee: Kicking canary 5% now. Running `bash ops/smoketests/iam_quickcheck.sh`.

lee: Smoke PASS: auth handshake OK, token refresh OK, cron job fired. Metrics look stable.

ops-oncall: No alerts triggered. Error rate within baseline. Latency unchanged.

toni: Rolling to 100% progressively over next 8m. Monitoring closely.

lee: Noted rollback commands in runbook:
`terraform state rm aws_iam_role.model_worker && terraform apply -target=module/iam --auto-approve`

mira: Everything green. Adding release note: "Added model_worker IAM role; provider pinned to 3.6.2 for release-2026.02. Runbook and rollback steps recorded." Closing thread. Thanks team.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup:
